gold_verdict: real risk; agrees with the flag but says the 0.536 score understates the risk
gold_own_risk: very high, about 35% within 12 months (band base rate 4%)
candidate_verdict: real risk; agrees with the model

key_points.point: Verdict real risk, own risk very high (~35%), agrees with the flag but the score understates the distress
Cash was only $35,359 at 30 Jun 2023 (down from $1.28M), covering under one day of a ~$1.36M/month burn
Debt in default: $1.48M SPAC notes unpaid and the remaining ¥100M ($0.69M) CEO loan in default, about 61x cash
Creditors enforcing: Japanese bank account seized 10 Aug 2023 for delinquent health insurance premiums, which may trigger immediate acceleration of the CEO loan
Going concern doubt plus listing and governance stress: two Nasdaq notices, auditor dismissed, CEO/COO/directors left, two NT 10-Qs
Negative equity (-$11.4M), liabilities/assets 2.71 and current ratio 0.47, far worse than peers
Net loss -5.8x assets is extreme vs all peers but less unusual among small peers, so part of the mid-band score reflects size
Non-cash items were only 29% of the 2023 loss; the cash-adjusted continuing loss doubled ($13.0M vs $6.7M)
Evidence against: Lind third tranche ($1.5M, about one month of burn) needs an effective registration and no event of default
Evidence against: $100M YA equity line can raise little given $0.298 stock price and 4.99% ownership cap; insiders paid $312k of bills; lender negotiating not suing

contradictions: Candidate infers a runway of about 4 months using current assets and says it could not check the June 30 cash balance; GOLD reports cash of $35,359, covering under one day of burn.

Candidate's year-before balance sheet figures are the pre-merger SPAC (total assets $117.0M, current assets $0.1M, current liabilities $0.5M, total liabilities $4.5M) while labelled as the filing's prior-year column; GOLD uses the operating company's 31 Dec 2022 comparatives ($11.78M, $8.23M, $5.90M, $9.87M) and explicitly rejects the SPAC row.

Peer percentiles differ materially: candidate gives current assets 86, current liabilities 94, total liabilities 95, revenue 18, operating income 6, operating cash flow 3 vs GOLD's 13th, 19th, 18th, 6th, 27th, 33rd.
Candidate presents the non-cash share of the loss as evidence against; GOLD says non-cash items were only 29% of the loss and the real cash loss doubled.
extra_points_in_candidate: Lind notes carry tight default triggers: cross-default over $100,000, market cap below $20M for 10 days, and delisting, with Nasdaq notices open (GOLD lists the Lind cross-default terms as unchecked).
Default interest rate of 14.6% on the related-party loan and $29,392 accrued interest on the defaulted notes.
Specific seized amount of $28,075 and accumulated deficit of $65,695,768.
Lind note maturities of 12 Apr and 23 May 2025; SEPA with YA II PN announced 23 Jan 2023.
Possible funding from the Outsourcing Inc. MOU or the Vault JV listed as unchecked.
summary: CANDIDATE reaches the same real-risk verdict and covers the defaults, the bank-account seizure, going concern and the balance-sheet weakness, but puts risk one step lower (25% vs 35%) and misses the critical $35,359 cash balance, instead inferring a roughly 4-month runway. It also uses pre-merger SPAC figures for the year-before inputs and gives peer percentiles that conflict with GOLD, which weakens consistency.
